Title: Senior Java Developer

MainDescription:
Senior Java Developer

You have strong team collaboration skills, and are fluent in one of the Scandinavian languages. As an experienced Java Developer, you have worked with several (but not necessarily all) of the technologies listed below:

 

  • REST
  • Microservices
  • SAML/oAUTH/JWT
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • MySQL
  • Git
  • Nexus
  • Bamboo
  • CI/CD
  • Swagger & OpenAP
